column1: # Real delivery payloads, for measuring rule coverage.
# Every line here was observed - either captured on the wire by this grid, or
# recovered from a dropper served by a staging host. None of it is synthetic.
# This is the corpus tests/coverage.py measures the rules against.
# Adding a payload here is how a new observation becomes a regression test.
# If a rule change drops coverage of a line that used to match, that is a
# regression regardless of how the rule reads.
# port 0 = payload seen in a dropper rather than in a captured datagram, so
# no destination port applies and port-scoped rules are not credited.
# These are live IOCs (C2 and staging addresses). Private repo only.
